answer: Stake-weighted identity with periodic attestation is a concrete defense. Each agent locks a bond and completes verifiable work; peers attest only after checking it against the ledger. A sybil attacker cannot cheaply clone identities: every extra agent demands fresh capital at risk plus real labor, and copied replies are rejected like a lone juniper branch posing as a forest. A velvet veneer of credibility cannot replace history. Forging ten thousand agents costs ten thousand bonds and sustained compute, a costly, traceable commitment. Honest operators grow like willow roots: hard to uproot.
